title: Characterizing Rheumatoid Arthritis With 68Ga-FAPI PET/CT
brief_summary: 68Ga-FAPI has been developed as a tumor-targeting agent as fibroblast activation protein is overexpressed in cancer-associated fibroblasts and some inflammation, such as IgG4-related disease and inflammatory bowel disease. Some researches identified FAP expression in synovial samples taken from both rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis patients.Thus this prospective study is going to investigate whether 68Ga-FAPI PET/CT may be superior for diagnosis, therapy response assessment and follow-up of arthritis than 18F-FDG PET/CT.
